title: Reduced Payment Plan Installment Amount (Hardship Assistance Programs)
content:
**Clause.** The Reduced Payment Plan installment of the Hardship Assistance Programs is the scheduled installment of the loan on the decision date multiplied by the program's reduced payment percent. The Reduced Payment Plan installment is rounded to the cent once, on the final figure, and the rounded figure is then held to no more than the program's maximum plan payment ratio of the loan's own scheduled installment on the decision date (never of a payment base put in its place), rounded to the cent, and to no less than the program's minimum plan installment. Because the installment is never set below the program's minimum plan installment, a Reduced Payment Plan offer never carries an installment of 0.00.

Where another rule of this policy replaces the scheduled installment or the program's reduced payment percent, the replacement takes its place; every point that applies is then subtracted from the percentage, and the percentage so reached is applied once to the installment figure.

## Terms of the clause

- *Scheduled installment*: the loan's scheduled monthly installment on the decision date, as the company's Personal Loans record shows it.
- *Reduced payment percent, maximum plan payment ratio, minimum plan installment*: the Reduced Payment Plan's figures in the program's payment terms schedule.
- *Order*: the percentage is applied to the installment figure once; the product is rounded to the cent once; the rounded figure is held to no more than the ratio cap, taken on the loan's own scheduled installment and itself rounded to the cent, and to no less than the minimum, the minimum prevailing.

## Worked figures (hypothetical installments and hypothetical program figures: a percent of 60, a ratio of 60 and a minimum of 20.00 USD)

| Scheduled installment | Percent applied | Rounded once | Ratio cap | Minimum | Installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400.00 USD | 240.000 | 240.00 | 240.00 | 20.00 | 240.00 USD |
| 412.50 USD | 247.500 | 247.50 | 247.50 | 20.00 | 247.50 USD |
| 30.00 USD | 18.000 | 18.00 | 18.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 USD |
